createOrReplace.title: Specific diploma requirements - TU Delft
createOrReplace.excerpt: A Levels: six GCSE in different subjects with grades A*-C (or 9-4), plus at least three A levels with grades A*-C. Mandatory GCE A Levels: Aerospace Engineering (English and Bilingual Stream) Mathematics + Physics; Computer Science & Engineering (English and Bilingual Stream) Mathematics. IB: TU Delft only accepts Mathematics Analysis & Approaches HL; IBCP not accepted. Aerospace Engineering: Mathematics AA HL + Physics HL; Computer Science & Engineering: Mathematics AA HL. US (AP): Computer Science & Engineering Calculus A/B or B/C (B/C preferred). Aerospace Engineering and Computer Science & Engineering are numerus clausus programmes (register before 15 January).
